name: lamport-proof-toolkit
description: Audit Lamport-style proof hierarchies and separately trace conclusion-first obligation graphs.

interface.shortDescription: Audit proof structure and conclusion obligations
interface.longDescription: Check an existing Lamport-style hierarchical proof forward for valid scope and construct discharge, or use the WWresearch reverse audit to trace its conclusion as a bounded AND/OR obligation graph. The reverse audit is not a method authored or endorsed by Leslie Lamport.
defaultPrompt: Audit this hierarchical Lamport proof for scope and validity.
Trace this proof backward as an AND/OR obligation graph.
Run both Lamport audits and keep their verdicts separate.
